description: Schedule a project to send to its full contact lists at a specific date and time. This commits a real bulk send to every contact on the lists once the scheduled time arrives.

confirm.description: Must be true to run this write operation. Set it only after the user has explicitly confirmed.

daily_cap_bypass.description: Optional. Run the whole project past the brand daily carrier limit instead of pausing at it. Only applies to brands T-Mobile meters (Aegis-vetted, non-political), which otherwise pause each Pacific day at their T-Mobile cap and must be started again to continue. Setting this accepts that messages to T-Mobile recipients over the limit may fail and are still billed. Defaults to false.

scheduled_at.description: ISO 8601 date-time at which to send (with offset). May be now or in the past - sending starts as soon as audience compilation finishes (no minimum lead time).

scheduled_timezone.description: One of the six supported US IANA zones

name: schedule_project
